title: Uhambo namaholide
description: Ten short, simple stories about travel and holidays: two friends camping in the Drakensberg, a bus held up by a protest, a boy, his grandmother and a bull, a couple on a Cape Town wine farm, a singing competition in Johannesburg, a visit to the Ncome battlefield, a stolen bag on a Durban beach, a traveller who falls ill in Mbombela, a young woman saving coins for a trip to Zimbabwe, and an old woman who draws the tourists by the sea.

lessons.title: Itende ehlathini
lessons.summary: Friends Phindile and Thabiso from Johannesburg camp in a Drakensberg valley: they pitch their tent by the forest, keep a fire burning against the wild animals, put it out before sleeping, wash in the river at dawn and watch the birds.
lessons.text:
UPhindile noThabiso bangabangane. Bahlala eGoli. NgoDisemba bafuna ukuphumula kude nedolobha. Bahamba ngemoto baya eDrakensberg. Lapho kukhona izintaba ezinkulu nesigodi esihle. Esigodini kukhona ihlathi elikhulu nomfula omncane.

Bafika esigodini emini. Bakhipha itende emotweni. Bakha itende eduze nehlathi. Itende labo lincane, kodwa liqinile.

Ebusuku bakha umlilo ngaphandle kwetende. Umlilo uyavutha kahle. Bahlala eduze komlilo ovuthayo, badla inyama. Ehlathini bezwa umsindo wezilwane zasendle. UPhindile uyabuza: "Izilwane zasendle zizofika lapha na?" UThabiso uthi: "Cha. Izilwane zasendle ziyawesaba umlilo ovuthayo."

Ngaphambi kokulala uThabiso ucisha umlilo ngamanzi. Uthi: "Kumele sicishe umlilo. Umlilo ovutha ebusuku ungashisa ihlathi lonke." Bangena etendeni. Bakhathele kakhulu ngemuva kohambo olude. Balala ngokushesha.

Ekuseni izinyoni zenza umsindo omnandi ehlathini. UPhindile uyasukuma kuqala. Uphuma etendeni, abheke izinyoni. Kukhona izinyoni eziningi ezihlahleni. Ezinye izinyoni zimnyama, ezinye zimhlophe.

UPhindile uya emfuleni. Ugeza ubuso nezandla zakhe emanzini omfula. Amanzi omfula ahlanzekile. Bese uThabiso uyasukuma. Naye uya emfuleni, ageze.

Emini bahamba ehlathini. Bahamba amahora amane. Babona izinyoni ezinhle nezilwane zasendle ezincane. Ngaphambi kobusuku babuyela etendeni. Bakhathele futhi, kodwa bayajabula.

Ngosuku lokugcina bacisha umlilo kahle. Bathatha itende labo, balibeke emotweni. UPhindile uthi: "Ngonyaka ozayo sizobuya kulesi sigodi." UThabiso uthi: "Yebo. Ngithanda leli hlathi nezinyoni zalo."

Imibuzo:
UPhindile noThabiso baya eDrakensberg na?
Kunjalo, bahamba ngemoto baya eDrakensberg.
Bakha itende labo eduze nehlathi na?
Kunjalo, bakha itende eduze nehlathi.
UThabiso ucisha umlilo ngaphambi kokulala na?
Kunjalo, ucisha umlilo ngamanzi.
Ekuseni uPhindile uyasukuma kuqala na?
Kunjalo, uyasukuma kuqala, abheke izinyoni.
UPhindile ugeza emfuleni na?
Kunjalo, ugeza ubuso nezandla emanzini omfula.
Bakhathele ngemuva kohambo olude na?
Kunjalo, bakhathele kakhulu, ngakho balala ngokushesha.

lessons.title: Ibhasi nombhikisho
lessons.summary: Nondumiso takes a fast bus from Durban to Pretoria for her first day at a new job; a protest crowd blocks the road, the passengers worry and two of them argue, until the minister arrives and the crowd lets the bus through.
lessons.text:
UNondumiso uhlala eThekwini. NgoLwesibili uthatha ibhasi elikhulu, aye ePitoli. Kusasa unomhlangano wokuqala emsebenzini wakhe omusha. Unephepha elinekheli lehhovisi elisha. Ubheka ikheli njalo, ngoba akafuni ukulahleka.

Ebhasini kunabagibeli abaningi. Umgibeli ngamunye unesihlalo sakhe. Ibhasi lihamba ngesivinini esikhulu emgwaqweni omkhulu. Abagibeli bayajabula, ngoba bazofika ngesikhathi.

Kodwa eduze nePitoli ibhasi limile. Phambili emgwaqweni kukhona isixuku esikhulu. Kunombhikisho. Abantu bombhikisho bavimbe umgwaqo ngamatshe. Bathi: "Asinawo amanzi esigodini sethu! Sifuna ukukhuluma nongqongqoshe!" Isixuku sivimba umgwaqo wonke. Akukho moto edlulayo.

Abagibeli bayakhathazeka. UNondumiso uyakhathazeka kakhulu. Ubheka ikheli ephepheni lakhe futhi. Uthi: "Ngizofika kade."

Abagibeli ababili bayaphikisana. Umgibeli wokuqala uthi: "Masiphume, sihambe ngezinyawo." Umgibeli wesibili uthi: "Cha, kumele sihlale ebhasini. Isixuku sikhulu kakhulu." Baphikisana isikhathi eside. Abanye abagibeli bathi: "Ningaphikisani. Lindani."

Ngemuva kwehora kufika imoto emnyama. Ungqongqoshe uphuma emotweni. Ukhuluma nesixuku. Uthi: "Ngiyezwa. Ngizonisiza ngamanzi. Ngicela nidedele umgwaqo, abantu bahambe." Abantu bombhikisho bayavuma. Bathatha amatshe emgwaqweni. Isixuku sidedela ibhasi, lidlule.

Ibhasi liqhubeka ngesivinini. Manje abagibeli abakhathazeki. UNondumiso ufika ePitoli ebusuku. Ekuseni uthatha iphepha lakhe, alandele ikheli. Uthola ihhovisi elisha.

Uthi kowesifazane wehhovisi: "Izolo umbhikisho uvimbe umgwaqo, ngafika kade ePitoli." Owesifazane uthi: "Ungakhathazeki. Ufike ngesikhathi namuhla. Ngena."

Imibuzo:
UNondumiso uya ePitoli ngebhasi na?
Kunjalo, uthatha ibhasi elikhulu, aye ePitoli.
Ebhasini kunabagibeli abaningi na?
Kunjalo, kunabagibeli abaningi.
Isixuku sivimba umgwaqo na?
Kunjalo, isixuku sivimba umgwaqo wonke.
Abantu bombhikisho bafuna ukukhuluma nongqongqoshe na?
Kunjalo, bafuna ukukhuluma nongqongqoshe.
Isixuku siyalidedela ibhasi na?
Kunjalo, isixuku sidedela ibhasi, lidlule.
Ibhasi lihamba ngesivinini esikhulu na?
Kunjalo, lihamba ngesivinini esikhulu emgwaqweni omkhulu.

lessons.title: Inkunzi egcekeni
lessons.summary: Young Hlonipho from Durban visits his grandmother in Msinga and rakes her yard; when the neighbour's bull runs at him he jumps the stone wall and lands on his arm, but the doctor finds the bone sound and the pain soon goes.
lessons.text:
UHlonipho ungumfana omncane. Uhlala eThekwini nabazali bakhe. Isikole sivaliwe, ngakho uya kogogo wakhe eMsinga. Uthanda ukuvakasha kugogo wakhe. Ugogo uhlala emzini omdala, onegceke elikhulu. Igceke linodonga lwamatshe.

Ngosuku lokuqala ugogo uthi: "Hlonipho, ngicela ungisize. Igceke lingcolile." Unika uHlonipho ihhala. UHlonipho uthatha ihhala, ahlanze igceke. Usebenza ngehhala isikhathi eside. Igceke liba lihle futhi.

Umakhelwane kagogo unenkunzi enkulu emnyama. Ngalolo suku umnyango wegceke uvuliwe. Inkunzi ingena egcekeni. UHlonipho ubona inkunzi. Uyesaba kakhulu. Inkunzi imbheka, bese igijima iya kuye.

UHlonipho uphonsa ihhala phansi. Ugijima ngokushesha aye odongeni. Weqa udonga. Kodwa udonga lude. Uwa ngaphesheya kodonga. Uwa phezu kwengalo yakhe.

Ugogo uzwa umsindo ngaphandle. Uphuma endlini. Umakhelwane uyafika, akhiphe inkunzi yakhe egcekeni. Ugogo ubheka ingalo kaHlonipho. UHlonipho uthi: "Gogo, ngizwa ubuhlungu obukhulu engalweni yami." Ugogo uthi: "Ubuhlungu buzophela. Sizoya kudokotela."

Udokotela uhlola ingalo kaHlonipho. Uhlola ithambo lengalo. Uthi: "Ithambo alephukile. Ubuhlungu buvela ngoba uwile. Phumula izinsuku ezimbalwa. Ungeqi izindonga futhi."

UHlonipho uhlala endlini izinsuku ezintathu. Ubuhlungu bengalo buyaphela kancane. Ugogo umnika ukudla okumnandi.

Ngosuku lokugcina umakhelwane uthi: "Hlonipho, inkunzi yami ngeke iphinde ingene egcekeni likagogo wakho." UHlonipho uyajabula. Uthi: "Gogo, ngizobuya ngizovakasha futhi. Kodwa angizukweqa udonga futhi."

Imibuzo:
UHlonipho uthanda ukuvakasha kugogo wakhe na?
Kunjalo, uthanda ukuvakasha kugogo wakhe eMsinga.
UHlonipho uhlanza igceke ngehhala na?
Kunjalo, uhlanza igceke ngehhala.
Inkunzi ingena egcekeni na?
Kunjalo, inkunzi enkulu emnyama ingena egcekeni.
UHlonipho weqa udonga na?
Kunjalo, weqa udonga, uwa phezu kwengalo yakhe.
Ithambo lengalo kaHlonipho liphukile na?
Cha, udokotela uthi ithambo alephukile.

lessons.title: Iwayini elibomvu
lessons.summary: Married ten years, Mfanelo and Nolitha of Pietermaritzburg take the train to a Cape Town wine farm; Nolitha turns down the red wine and tells him she is pregnant, and he gives her a silver chain that becomes the family's treasure.
lessons.text:
UMfanelo noNolitha bashadile iminyaka eyishumi. Bahlala eMgungundlovu. Imihla ngemihla bayasebenza, futhi abanaso isikhathi sokuphumula. Ngakho uMfanelo uthi: "Masihambe siye eKapa. Sizojabulela isikhathi sethu ndawonye."

Bahamba ngesitimela baya eKapa. Lapho bavakashela ipulazi elikhulu lewayini. Ipulazi linezithelo eziningi. Abantu benza iwayini ngalezi zithelo. Kukhona iwayini elibomvu newayini elimhlophe.

Owesifazane wasepulazini uthi kuNolitha: "Nkosikazi, uthanda iwayini elibomvu na?" UNolitha uthi: "Cha, angiphuzi iwayini namuhla." UMfanelo uyamangala. Uthi: "Nolitha, uthanda iwayini elibomvu kakhulu! Kungani?"

UNolitha uyajabula. Uthi: "Mfanelo, ngikhulelwe. Sizoba nengane." UMfanelo uyajabula kakhulu. Uthi: "Lesi yisipho esikhulu kakhulu!" Ubamba uNolitha. UNolitha uthi: "Owesifazane okhulelwe akaphuzi iwayini. Ngizophuza amanzi." Owesifazane wasepulazini uthi: "Kulungile, nkosikazi. Ngizokunika amanzi."

UMfanelo uphuza iwayini elibomvu kancane. UNolitha uphuza amanzi. Bayakujabulela ukudla okumnandi nelanga elihle. Bakhuluma ngobudlelwane babo. UMfanelo uthi: "Ubudlelwane bethu buqinile. Imihla ngemihla ngiyajabula ngawe."

Ngemuva kwalokho uMfanelo uya esitolo esincane. Uthenga isipho sikaNolitha. Yintambo yesiliva. Intambo yesiliva incane futhi inhle. Ekuseni uMfanelo unika uNolitha isipho sakhe. Uthi: "Nkosikazi yami, uyigugu lami. Nengane yethu izoba yigugu lethu."

UNolitha ufaka intambo yesiliva. Uthi: "Ngiyayijabulela le ntambo. Ngizoyigcina, ibe yigugu lomndeni wethu."

Babuyela eMgungundlovu. Imihla ngemihla uNolitha ugqoka intambo yakhe yesiliva. Ngemuva kwezinyanga eziyisishiyagalombili uNolitha uthola ingane yentombazane.

Imibuzo:
UMfanelo noNolitha bavakashela ipulazi lewayini eKapa na?
Kunjalo, bavakashela ipulazi elikhulu lewayini.
UNolitha uphuza iwayini elibomvu na?
Cha, akaphuzi iwayini, ngoba ukhulelwe.
UMfanelo uthi ubudlelwane babo buqinile na?
Kunjalo, uthi ubudlelwane babo buqinile.
UMfanelo uthenga isipho sikaNolitha na?
Kunjalo, uthenga intambo yesiliva.
UNolitha uyayijabulela intambo yesiliva na?
Kunjalo, uthi uzoyigcina ibe yigugu lomndeni.

lessons.title: Umncintiswano wokucula
lessons.summary: Thobani from Umlazi and his drummer friend Lesedi take the bus to a big December singing competition in Johannesburg; Thobani finds the courage to sing a song of praise, the crowd records him on their phones, and he wins the gold cup and is carried on the shoulders.
lessons.text:
UThobani uhlala eMlazi. Uthanda ukucula. Umngane wakhe, uLesedi, ubetha isigubhu. Kulo nyaka eGoli kukhona umncintiswano omkhulu wokucula. Umklomelo wokuqala yindebe yegolide nemali eningi. UThobani noLesedi bathatha ibhasi, baye eGoli.

Emncintiswaneni kunabaculi abaningi abavela ezifundazweni eziningi. Bonke bacula kahle kakhulu. UThobani uyesaba. Uthi kuLesedi: "Anginaso isibindi sokucula lapho kunabantu abaningi."

ULesedi ubeka isandla ehlombe likaThobani. Uthi: "Unesibindi, mngane wami. Cabanga ngomama wakho. Abantu bazokuqopha, futhi umama wakho uzokubona ocingweni." UThobani uthatha umoya omningi. Uthi: "Kulungile. Ngizocula. Ngizocula emncintiswaneni."

Abantu abaningi bahlala enkundleni. Abanye babambe izingcingo zabo, ukuze baqophe abaculi. ULesedi ubetha isigubhu kancane. UThobani uqala ukucula. Ucula ingoma yokudumisa uNkulunkulu. Izwi lakhe liqinile futhi limnandi. Ucula ngesibindi.

Izwi likaThobani limangalisa abantu. Abantu bayasukuma, bashaye izandla. Abanye bayakhala. Abantu abaningi bayamqopha ngezingcingo zabo. Abahluleli nabo bayamangala. Omunye wabo uthi: "Le nsizwa iyasimangalisa!"

Ekugcineni abahluleli bathi: "Umklomelo wokuqala uya kuThobani waseMlazi!" UThobani uthatha indebe yegolide. Indebe inkulu futhi iyakhanya. Uthola nemali yomklomelo. Abantu bayamdumisa. Bathi: "Thobani! Thobani!" ULesedi nabanye abantu baphakamisa uThobani, bamthwale emahlombe abo. UThobani uhlala emahlombe abo, aphakamise indebe.

Ebusuku uThobani ushayela unina ucingo. Unina uthi: "Ngikubonile ocingweni! Abantu bakuqophile. Uculile kahle kakhulu." UThobani uthi: "Mama, ngicule ingoma yokudumisa uNkulunkulu. Kodwa umklomelo ngowethu sobabili noLesedi. Ubethe isigubhu kahle kakhulu." Unina uthi: "Uyangimangalisa, ndodana yami!"

Imibuzo:
UThobani uthanda ukucula na?
Kunjalo, uthanda ukucula.
ULesedi ubetha isigubhu na?
Kunjalo, ubetha isigubhu.
Ekuqaleni uThobani unesibindi sokucula na?
Cha, uyesaba ekuqaleni.
Abantu bayamqopha uThobani ngezingcingo na?
Kunjalo, abantu abaningi bayamqopha.
UThobani uthatha indebe nomklomelo wokuqala na?
Kunjalo, uthatha indebe yegolide nemali yomklomelo.

lessons.title: Amaqhawe aseNcome
lessons.summary: Kgomotso from Pretoria visits Ncome to learn Zulu history; Xolisile, a Zulu woman who works there, tells how in 1838 the enemy came armed with guns, how the Zulu generals' strategy failed and many warriors died for their king, and shows her an old bullet.
lessons.text:
UKgomotso uhlala ePitoli. NgoDisemba uvakashela iKwaZulu-Natal. Ufuna ukufunda izindaba zakudala zamaZulu. Ngakho uya eNcome. Lapho, eduze nomfula, kwaba nempi enkulu kudala.

Owesifazane osebenza lapho, uXolisile, uxoxa noKgomotso. Uthi: "NgingumZulu. Ngifuna ukukutshela indaba yamaZulu nezitha zawo."

UXolisile uthi: "Ngonyaka 1838 izitha zafika lapha nezinqola zazo. Izitha zahloma ngezibhamu. AmaZulu nawo ahloma, kodwa ahloma ngezikhali zawo zakudala, hhayi ngezibhamu."

Bese uthi: "Izinduna zamaZulu zenza iqhinga. Zafuna ukuthi amaqhawe ahlasele izitha ezinhlangothini ezimbili. Kodwa iqhinga labo alizange lisebenze. Umfula wavimba amaqhawe amaningi."

UKgomotso uyabuza: "Kwenzekeni lapho amaqhawe efika ezitheni?" UXolisile uthi: "Izitha zadubula amaZulu ngezibhamu. Zadubula isikhathi eside. Inhlamvu ihamba ngesivinini esikhulu. Amaqhawe ambalwa afinyelela ezitheni, azigwaze ngezikhali zawo. Kodwa amaZulu amaningi abhubha ngalolo suku."

UXolisile uthi: "Amaqhawe amaningi afela inkosi yawo nezwe lawo. Abantu bathi amanzi omfula aba bomvu ngegazi. Kodwa amaZulu awakhohlwa amaqhawe awo. Namuhla siyawakhumbula. Abantu abaningi bomndeni wami babhubha lapha. Bafela inkosi yabo."

UXolisile ukhombisa uKgomotso inhlamvu endala. Uthi: "Le nhlamvu yatholakala eduze nomfula." UKgomotso ubheka inhlamvu isikhathi eside.

Namuhla eNcome kukhona izakhiwo ezimbili. Esinye isakhiwo sixoxa indaba yamaZulu. Esinye sixoxa indaba yezitha zawo. Phakathi kwazo kukhona umfula. UKgomotso uvakashela zombili. Ekugcineni uthi: "Namuhla ngifunde okuningi. Amaqhawe amaZulu ngeke ngiwakhohlwe."

Imibuzo:
UKgomotso uya eNcome na?
Kunjalo, uya eNcome ukufunda izindaba zamaZulu.
Izitha zahloma ngezibhamu na?
Kunjalo, zahloma ngezibhamu.
Iqhinga lezinduna lasebenza na?
Cha, iqhinga labo alizange lisebenze.
Amaqhawe amaningi afela inkosi yawo na?
Kunjalo, amaqhawe amaningi afela inkosi yawo, abhubha ngalolo suku.
UXolisile ungumZulu na?
Kunjalo, uthi: "NgingumZulu."
Amaqhawe ambalwa agwaza izitha na?
Kunjalo, amaqhawe ambalwa afinyelela ezitheni, azigwaze.

lessons.title: Isikhwama sikaPhilisiwe
lessons.summary: A thief steals rich Philisiwe's bag on a Durban beach; Sphamandla, a poor boy from the shacks nearby, points out where he ran and brings the bag back, and since his mother will not take money, they agree that Philisiwe will pay for his school books and uniform.
lessons.text:
UPhilisiwe ungowesifazane ocebile waseGoli. Unemali eningi nemoto enhle. Kulo nyaka uvakasha eThekwini. Ngolunye usuku uhlala olwandle. Ubeka isikhwama sakhe eceleni kwakhe, alale elangeni.

Indoda ifika ngokushesha. Yeba isikhwama sakhe, igijime. UPhilisiwe uyavuka. Uthi: "Isikhwama sami! Umuntu webile isikhwama sami!" Esikhwameni kukhona imali nocingo lwakhe.

Umfana omncane, uSphamandla, ubone konke. USphamandla ungumfana ompofu. Uhlala nonina emjondolo eduze nolwandle. Ukhomba ngenkomba yakhe. Uthi: "Indoda eyebile isikhwama sakho igijimele lapho, emijondolo."

USphamandla ugijima, alandele indoda. Ngemuva kwesikhashana uyabuya nesikhwama. Uthi: "Ngifumene isikhwama sakho ngemuva komjondolo. Indoda ilahla isikhwama, yabaleka." UPhilisiwe uvula isikhwama. Imali ikhona, nocingo lukhona.

UPhilisiwe uthi: "Ngiyakubonga kakhulu. Ngizokunika imali." USphamandla uthi: "Cha. Ekhaya lethu kujwayelekile ukusiza umuntu."

UPhilisiwe uhamba noSphamandla aye emjondolo wabo. Umjondolo wabo mncane. Unina kaSphamandla uthi: "Simpofu. USphamandla akayi esikoleni, ngoba asinayo imali yezincwadi nezingubo zesikole."

UPhilisiwe ufuna ukumnika imali. Kodwa unina uthi: "Cha. Asifuni imali yakho." UPhilisiwe uyamncenga: "Ngiyakuncenga, ngivumele ngisize. Ngicebile, futhi ngifuna ukusiza. Indodana yakho ifumene isikhwama sami." Unina uthi: "Simpofu, kodwa ngokujwayelekile asiceli imali." UPhilisiwe uyamncenga futhi.

UPhilisiwe uyacabanga. Uthi: "Ake sithole isixazululo ndawonye. Isixazululo yilesi: ngiyakuthembisa ukuthi ngizokhokhela izincwadi nezingubo zesikole zikaSphamandla. Angizukunika imali. Ngizokhokhela isikole ngqo." Unina uyavuma. Uthi: "Lesi yisixazululo esihle."

Ngonyaka olandelayo uSphamandla uya esikoleni. UPhilisiwe wenza lokho akuthembisile unyaka nonyaka. Ngokujwayelekile ubuyela eThekwini njalo ngoDisemba, avakashele uSphamandla nonina.

Imibuzo:
UPhilisiwe ungowesifazane ocebile na?
Kunjalo, unemali eningi nemoto enhle.
Indoda yeba isikhwama sikaPhilisiwe na?
Kunjalo, yeba isikhwama sakhe, igijime.
USphamandla uhlala emjondolo na?
Kunjalo, uhlala nonina emjondolo eduze nolwandle.
USphamandla ukhomba ngenkomba yakhe na?
Kunjalo, ukhomba ngenkomba yakhe emijondolo.
USphamandla uyasifumana isikhwama na?
Kunjalo, usifumana ngemuva komjondolo.
UPhilisiwe uthembisa ukukhokhela izincwadi zikaSphamandla na?
Kunjalo, uthembisa ukukhokhela izincwadi nezingubo zesikole.

lessons.title: UDuduzile empumalanga
lessons.summary: Duduzile from Soweto rarely travels, but this year she takes the train east to Mbombela to see the wild animals; she falls ill in her rented room, needs an operation and is made to stay a week in hospital, where her faith and the kind worker Bonolo, her 'angel', help her through.
lessons.text:
UDuduzile uhlala eSoweto. Ungowesifazane osebenza kanzima. Ngokwemvamisa akahambi kude, ngoba unomsebenzi omningi. Kodwa kulo nyaka uthatha isikhathi sokuphumula. Uhamba ngesitimela aye empumalanga, eMbombela. Ufuna ukubona izintaba nezilwane zasendle zasempumalanga.

UDuduzile ufika eMbombela ebusuku. Uqasha igumbi elincane endlini enkulu. Igumbi lakhe lihle futhi lihlanzekile. Ulala kahle.

Kodwa ngosuku lwesibili uDuduzile uyagula. Uzwa ubuhlungu obukhulu esiswini. Akakwazi ukusukuma. Imvamisa akaguli, ngakho uyethuka. Owesifazane wendlu ufika egumbini lakhe, ambone. Uthi: "Uyagula kakhulu. Sizoya esibhedlela."

Esibhedlela udokotela uhlola isisu sikaDuduzile. Uthi: "Kumele ngikuhlinze namuhla." UDuduzile uyesaba ukuhlinzwa. Kodwa udokotela uthi: "Ungesabi. Ngihlinza abantu abaningi. Imvamisa abantu baphila kahle ngemuva kwesonto."

UDuduzile ukhuleka kuNkulunkulu. Unokholo oluqinile. Uthi: "Nkulunkulu, ngiyakwazi ukuthi uzongisiza." Bese udokotela uyamhlinza. Konke kuhamba kahle.

Ngemuva kokuhlinzwa udokotela uthi: "Namuhla ungadli lutho. Phuza umthamo wamanzi kuphela." UDuduzile uphuza umthamo omncane wamanzi. Bese udokotela uthi: "Uzohlala lapha isonto lonke." UDuduzile uphoqwa ukuhlala esibhedlela. Ngosuku olulandelayo uphuza umthamo omkhulu wamanzi, adle kancane.

UDuduzile uyadabuka. Uthi: "Ngize empumalanga ukubona izilwane zasendle. Manje ngiphoqwa ukuhlala esibhedlela." Uyadabuka kakhulu.

Owesifazane osebenza esibhedlela, uBonolo, uyamnakekela imini nobusuku. Uletha ukudla, uletha namanzi. Ukhuluma noDuduzile njalo. UDuduzile uthi: "Bonolo, uyingelosi yami." UBonolo uyajabula. Uthi: "Ngiyisisebenzi nje. Ngenza umsebenzi wami."

Ngemuva kwesonto uDuduzile uphilile futhi. Ngaphambi kokubuyela eSoweto, uBonolo uhamba naye ayobona izilwane zasendle. Manje uDuduzile akadabukile. Uthi: "Ukholo lwami lungisizile. Nengelosi yami ingisizile."

Imibuzo:
UDuduzile uya empumalanga na?
Kunjalo, uhamba ngesitimela aye eMbombela.
UDuduzile uyagula egumbini lakhe na?
Kunjalo, uzwa ubuhlungu obukhulu esiswini.
Udokotela uyamhlinza uDuduzile na?
Kunjalo, uyamhlinza, futhi konke kuhamba kahle.
UDuduzile uphoqwa ukuhlala esibhedlela na?
Kunjalo, uhlala esibhedlela isonto lonke.
UDuduzile uthi uBonolo uyingelosi yakhe na?
Kunjalo, uthi: "Bonolo, uyingelosi yami."
UDuduzile unokholo na?
Kunjalo, unokholo oluqinile, futhi ukhuleka kuNkulunkulu.

lessons.title: Izinhlamvu zemali zikaLethiwe
lessons.summary: Lethiwe of Durban finishes her studies and dreams of the great waterfall in Zimbabwe, to the north; her plan is to save a coin or two every night in a bowl, her way of life changes, and after a year the heap of coins pays for the long bus journey.
lessons.text:
ULethiwe uhlala eThekwini. Kulo nyaka uphothula izifundo zakhe. Usebenza esitolo esincane, kodwa akanayo imali eningi. Unephupho elilodwa: ufuna ukuhambela enyakatho, eZimbabwe, ukuze abone impophoma enkulu.

ULethiwe unecebo. Icebo lakhe lilula: uzonga imali nsuku zonke. Ubeka isitsha esikhulu endlini yakhe. Njalo ebusuku ufaka uhlamvu lwemali esitsheni. Ngezinye izinsuku ufaka izinhlamvu ezimbili noma ezintathu.

Impilo kaLethiwe iyaguquka. Manje akathengi izingubo ezintsha. Akadli ukudla kwasesitolo. Uyonga kakhulu. Abangane bakhe bathi: "Lethiwe, uguqukile!" ULethiwe uthi: "Kunjalo. Ngiyonga, ngoba nginecebo."

Isitsha siyagcwala kancane. Ngemuva kwezinyanga eziyisithupha kukhona inqwaba yezinhlamvu zemali esitsheni. Ngolunye usuku uLethiwe ukhipha izinhlamvu zonke esitsheni. Uyazididiyela phansi. Udidiyela izinhlamvu eziyishumi ndawonye, bese edidiyela ezinye eziyishumi. Ekugcineni phansi kukhona inqwaba enkulu yezinhlamvu zemali. Uzididiyela kahle, ukuze azibale. Imali ayanele.

ULethiwe uyaqhubeka ukonga. Ngemuva konyaka wonke imali yanele. Unemali yebhasi, yokudla neyendawo yokulala.

Ekugcineni uLethiwe uqalisa uhambo lwakhe. Uthatha ibhasi elikhulu eThekwini. Ibhasi liphumela emgwaqweni omkhulu oya enyakatho. Lihamba ubusuku bonke nosuku lonke. ULethiwe ubheka izwe. Izwe liyaguquka: izintaba ziyaguquka, izihlahla nazo ziyaguquka.

ULethiwe ufika eZimbabwe. Uphumela ngaphandle kwebhasi, ahambe ayobona impophoma. Abanye abagibeli nabo baphumela ngaphandle. Amanzi amaningi awa phansi ngomsindo omkhulu. ULethiwe uyajabula kakhulu. Uthi: "Uhlamvu ngalunye lwemali lungilethe lapha."

Imibuzo:
ULethiwe uphothula izifundo zakhe na?
Kunjalo, uphothula izifundo zakhe kulo nyaka.
ULethiwe ufuna ukuhambela enyakatho na?
Kunjalo, ufuna ukuhambela eZimbabwe, enyakatho.
Icebo likaLethiwe ukonga imali na?
Kunjalo, uyonga imali nsuku zonke.
Kukhona inqwaba yezinhlamvu zemali esitsheni na?
Kunjalo, kukhona inqwaba enkulu yezinhlamvu zemali.
ULethiwe uqalisa uhambo lwakhe na?
Kunjalo, uqalisa uhambo lwakhe ngebhasi.
ULethiwe ufaka uhlamvu lwemali esitsheni na?
Kunjalo, njalo ebusuku ufaka uhlamvu lwemali esitsheni.

lessons.title: Imidwebo kaNombali
lessons.summary: Old Nombali makes cheap pictures of tourists on small pieces of cloth by the Durban sea; she draws a boy's big nose and missing tooth and turns a red spot into a little sun, and Tshepo, who has an art shop in Johannesburg, offers her a contract for bigger pictures that change her way of life.
lessons.text:
UNombali ungumfazi omdala waseThekwini. Wenza imidwebo yabantu. Njalo ngoDisemba uhlala eduze nolwandle. Abavakashi abaningi bafika lapho. UNombali wenza imidwebo yabo ezindwangwini. Indwangu ngayinye incane, futhi umdwebo ngamunye awubizi kakhulu.

Ngolunye usuku kufika umfana omncane nobaba wakhe. Umfana ufuna umdwebo wakhe. UNombali ubheka ubuso bomfana. Umfana unekhala elikhulu, futhi akanalo izinyo elilodwa phambili. UNombali wenza ikhala elikhulu emdwebeni. Wenza nendawo yezinyo elingekho. Umfana uyajabula kakhulu. Uthi: "Baba, bheka! Ngibona ikhala lami, ngibona nendawo yezinyo lami!"

Kodwa ngesikhathi uNombali esebenza, kuwa ibala elibomvu endwangwini. UNombali akakhathazeki. Wenza ibala libe yilanga elincane elibomvu phezu kwekhanda lomfana. Ubaba uthi: "Leli bala lenza umdwebo ube muhle kakhulu."

Indoda, uTshepo, ime eduze. Ibuka imidwebo kaNombali. UTshepo unesitolo esikhulu sezinto zobuciko eGoli. Uthi: "Mama, imidwebo yakho mihle. Kumele ibonwe ngabantu abaningi. Lapha olwandle ibonwa ngabantu abambalwa kuphela."

UTshepo ufuna ukuthengisa imidwebo kaNombali esitolo sakhe. Kodwa ufuna ubukhulu obuthile. Uthi: "Ubukhulu bezindwangu zakho buncane. Ngifuna imidwebo emikhulu." Ubhala inkontileka. Inkontileka ithi: "UNombali uzothumela imidwebo emikhulu eyishumi nyanga zonke." UNombali ufunda inkontileka kahle. Bese uyayisayina. Umfazi omdala uyajabula kakhulu.

Inhlalo kaNombali iyaguquka. Manje akahlali endlini encane. Uhlala endlini enkulu, futhi unemali eyanele. Uthenga izindwangu ezinkulu. Imidwebo yakhe ibonwa ngabantu abaningi eGoli. Ubukhulu bemidwebo yakhe buyamjabulisa.

Kodwa uNombali akayeki ukuhlala eduze nolwandle njalo ngonyaka. Uthi: "Inhlalo yami intsha, kodwa ngithanda abavakashi abancane namanje, namakhala abo, namazinyo abo."

Imibuzo:
UNombali ungumfazi omdala na?
Kunjalo, ungumfazi omdala waseThekwini.
Umfana unekhala elikhulu na?
Kunjalo, unekhala elikhulu, futhi akanalo izinyo elilodwa.
Kuwa ibala elibomvu endwangwini na?
Kunjalo, kuwa ibala elibomvu, kodwa ulenza ilanga.
UTshepo ubhala inkontileka na?
Kunjalo, ubhala inkontileka, futhi uNombali uyayisayina.
Inhlalo kaNombali iyaguquka na?
Kunjalo, manje imidwebo yakhe ibonwa ngabantu abaningi, futhi uhlala endlini enkulu.
